roadmap.title: Early story and side quests
roadmap.description: Play from Aliahan to the ship. Add the optional side events as you pass them.

roadmap.title: Middle story
roadmap.description: Follow the orb quests to the Everbird. Metal slimes and sparkly spots open up here.

roadmap.title: Baramos and Alefgard
roadmap.description: Finish the story. Complete the helmet and sword quests in Alefgard.

roadmap.title: Post-game cleanup
roadmap.description: Fight Xenlon, clear the Temple of Trials and fill every collection.

achievements.description: Awarded for unlocking all other achievements.
achievements.summary: Unlock all 41 other achievements.

steps.text: Finish every other achievement. This one unlocks last.

achievements.description: Awarded for leaving Aliahan.
achievements.summary: Leave Aliahan for the first time.

steps.text: Walk out of Aliahan after the opening story scenes.

achievements.description: Awarded for leaving the Shrine of Promise.
achievements.summary: Finish the Path of Promise and leave the Shrine of Promise.

steps.text: Go through the Path of Promise dungeon and walk out of the Shrine of Promise.

achievements.description: Awarded for defeating Robbin' 'Ood.
achievements.summary: Defeat Robbin' 'Ood at Skyfell Tower.

steps.text: Climb Skyfell Tower and fight Robbin' 'Ood and his three minions.
Kill the minions first. All of them use only physical attacks.
Cast Sap to lower their defense and raise your own defense to cut the damage.

achievements.description: Awarded for defeating the Ripper of the Rift.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Ripper of the Rift in the Pyramid.

steps.text: Fight the Ripper of the Rift in the Pyramid.
Kill the two Kylla first. They put your party to sleep and heal the others.
Seal its spells with Fizzle or the Staff of Antimagic, and use lightning attacks. Bring plenty of healing items.

achievements.description: Awarded for defeating Robbin' 'Ood...again.
achievements.summary: Defeat Robbin' 'Ood a second time in Kidnapper's Cave.

steps.text: Fight Robbin' 'Ood and his minions in Kidnapper's Cave.
Defeat the minions first; ice magic hurts them badly. Cast Sap on Robbin' 'Ood to weaken his defense.

achievements.description: Awarded for obtaining your very own ship.
achievements.summary: Receive your own ship from Portoga.

steps.text: Finish Kidnapper's Cave by saving the girl. This gives you the black pepper.
Bring the black pepper back to Portoga.
Take the ship the king promised you.

achievements.description: Awarded for defeating Orochi.
achievements.summary: Defeat Orochi.

guide.context: Heal between the two fights, because the second starts as soon as you enter her room.

steps.text: Go to Jipang and enter Orochi's Lair, then defeat Orochi.
Return to Jipang and defeat Orochi in the second fight.
Orochi uses fire breath and paralysis. Asbestos Earrings from Mur and the Tingle spell or Full Moon Rings help.

achievements.description: Awarded for defeating the Chiromancer.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Chiromancer in Gaia's Navel.

steps.text: Use the Ultimate Key to open Gaia's Navel in the north of Lanson.
Go down to B3 and fight the Chiromancer and the Madvlad.
Kill the Madvlad first. Both are weak to lightning, so use the Hero's lightning skills.

achievements.description: Awarded for defeating the dying fires.
achievements.summary: Defeat the dying fires at Theddon.

steps.text: Finish the Ultimate Key quest, then go to Theddon at night.
Fight the dying fires and take the Green Orb.
Kill all of them in the same turn, or they keep calling more. Kacrackle hits every enemy.
Bring Dieamends for their instant-kill Whack, and keep Magic Barrier up.

achievements.description: Awarded for defeating the boss troll that had disguised itself as Manoza's ruler.
achievements.summary: Defeat the boss troll that was disguised as the ruler of Manoza.

steps.text: Go to Manoza Castle and use Ra's Mirror on the disguised ruler.
Defeat the Boss Troll.
Seal its spells with Fizzle. Keep defense buffs up to survive its Desperate Attack.

achievements.description: Awarded for defeating the Garboyle.
achievements.summary: Defeat Garboyle at the top of Mt. Necrogond.

steps.text: Climb to the top of Mt. Necrogond and fight Garboyle.
Garboyle uses fire magic and breath. Wear fire-resistant gear from Mur such as Asbestos Earrings.

achievements.description: Awarded for reviving Ramia.
achievements.summary: Revive Ramia by placing all six orbs at the Shrine of the Everbird.

steps.text: Collect all six orbs. Some come from boss fights: the Green Orb from the dying fires at Theddon, the blue orb from the Chiromancer, and the Silver Orb from the man at Necrogond Shrine.
Sail to the Shrine of the Everbird on the icy island in the south-west and place the orbs on its pedestals.

achievements.description: Awarded for defeating Baramos.
achievements.summary: Defeat Baramos in his throne room.

steps.text: Fight Baramos in his throne room in Baramos's Lair.
Wear Clarity Rings to block Fuddle. Use Insulatle and Magic Barrier against his breath and spells.
Learn Multiheal first. His Kaboom hits the whole party.

achievements.description: Awarded for setting foot in Alefgard.
achievements.summary: Set foot in Alefgard.

steps.text: Continue the story after defeating Baramos until you arrive in Alefgard.

achievements.description: Awarded for freeing Rubiss.
achievements.summary: Free Rubiss by beating the Soul of Baramos on the summit of the Tower of Rubiss.

steps.text: Climb the Tower of Rubiss and fight the Soul of Baramos on the top floor.

achievements.description: Awarded for summoning forth the bridge of the rain's bow.
achievements.summary: Form the rainbow bridge that leads to Zoma's domain.

steps.text: Gather the Staff of Rain, the Sacred Amulet and the Sunstone. Together they make the Rainbow Drop.
Take the Rainbow Drop to the peninsula that leads toward Zoma's Citadel and use it to raise the bridge.

achievements.description: Awarded for completing the game's story.
achievements.summary: Defeat Zoma to finish the story.

steps.text: Cross the rainbow bridge and enter Zoma's Citadel.
Defeat Zoma, Lord of the Underworld.

achievements.description: Awarded for filling up the Defeated Monster List.
achievements.summary: Defeat each of the 163 monsters in the Defeated Monster List at least once.

guide.context: This needs all post-game bosses, including Xenlon and the Grand Dragon. Avoid instant-kill moves like Blasto on mimic-type enemies until each type is listed, because they may not register. Save before fighting a mimic type you have not listed, so you can reload.

achievements.description: Awarded for obtaining 250 items.
achievements.summary: Obtain 250 different items.

guide.context: Only different items count, so buying many of one item does not help. The game has 300 different items.

steps.text: Open the Info tab of the pause menu to see your item count and what is missing.
Pick up items from sparkly spots and claim mini medal prizes to raise the count.

achievements.description: Awarded for learning all spells and abilities.
achievements.summary: Learn every spell and ability across all vocations.

guide.context: The levels shown are close; your Wisdom stat can shift them by a few levels.

collectibles.name: Sage
collectibles.location: Reach about level 40; also gives every Priest and Mage spell

collectibles.name: Priest (skip if you level a Sage)
Mage (skip if you level a Sage)
Monster Wrangler
collectibles.location: Reach about level 44; the last ability, Fog of War, also needs 100 recruited monsters

achievements.description: Awarded for obtaining the grand medal.
achievements.summary: Win the Grand Dragon fight in 20 turns or fewer to earn the Grand Medal.

guide.context: The five trials cost a lot of gold. Ten Elfin Elixirs alone cost 400,000. Save your Monster Arena prize gold for them.

steps.text: Defeat Xenlon once and pick the blank wish to open the Temple of Trials.
Fly with Ramia high above the sea north of Aliahan and enter the rift in the sky.
South chamber: recruit at least 110 friendly monsters, then talk to the spirit.
South-west chamber: give the spirit 4 Hardwood Headwear, 4 Staff of Sentencing, 4 Epic Apron, 4 Slime Earrings, 25 Magic Water, 10 Elfin Elixir and 4 Flame Armour.
steps.note: Hardwood Headwear is sold in Khoryv, Staff of Sentencing in Baharata, Epic Apron in the town your merchant built, Slime Earrings in Kol, Magic Water in Cloudsgate Citadel, Elfin Elixir in the Faerie Village and Flame Armour in Rimuldar. Elfin Elixir costs 40,000 gold each, and the village shop needs the Mod Rod. The spirit keeps these items.

steps.text: South-east chamber: show the spirit a Mod Rod, a Gringham Whip, the Auroral Helm and the Sword of Kings. It does not keep them.
steps.note: The Gringham Whip is the prize for 105 mini medals, or it is in a chest in the north-east chamber. Win ranks 8 and 9 of the Monster Arena in Cantlin for the Mod Rod.

steps.text: North-east chamber: equip only axes or staves, solve the boulder puzzle, and beat two groups of Pandora's Boxes.
steps.note: With the wrong weapons you deal 10% damage and take much more. Blasto removes Pandora's Boxes.

steps.text: North-west chamber: equip only boomerangs or claws, cross the teleporter maze, and beat two groups of Pandora's Boxes.
steps.note: With the wrong weapons you deal 10% damage and take much more. Blasto removes Pandora's Boxes.

steps.text: Walk the north road and fight the Grand Dragon. Win in 20 turns or fewer.
Have the Hero heal, and give the other three Wild Side and Monster Pile-On at level 45 or higher.
steps.note: Bring a Sunstone to wake sleeping party members.

achievements.description: Awarded for having Xenlon grant every one of your wishes.
achievements.summary: Defeat Xenlon seven times so that every one of his wishes is granted.

guide.context: Each win grants one wish. The first win must take 35 turns or fewer, the second 25 or fewer, and every later win 15 or fewer.

steps.text: Take the north teleporter in the Dragon Queen's castle, pass the field and the cave to Cloudsgate Citadel, then leave by the lower door and climb the ladders to Xenlon.
Defeat Xenlon and choose a wish each time. Repeat until all seven wishes are used.
The Hero heals with Omniheal. Monster Wranglers use Wild Side and then Monster Pile-On for fast damage.
steps.note: The last wish, More Guns n Buns, only appears after the other six are chosen. Xenlon removes your buffs late in the fight.

steps.text: Choose the blank wish at some point to open the Temple of Trials.

achievements.description: Awarded for rescuing all friendly monsters.
achievements.summary: Rescue all 121 friendly monsters.

guide.context: With a Monster Wrangler in the party, walk up and talk to them. Without one, use Fade, a Pouch of Musk or Padfoot first. The Wrangler's Animal Instinct shows nearby ones. Some only appear at certain times of day. Disguised ones need Ra's Mirror. An Overtoad and a Restless Armor are met during the Hero's solo trials at Gaia's Navel, so recruit them on your first visit.

achievements.description: Awarded for winning the rank-11 monster arena tournament.
achievements.summary: Win the top Monster Arena tournament, rank 11.

guide.context: Ranks 10 and 11 are in Jipang and open only after you defeat Xenlon and choose the new Monster Arena wish.

steps.text: Defeat Xenlon within the turn limit and choose the new Monster Arena wish.
Go to the well in Jipang and win ranks 10 and 11.
Use three recruited monsters. Several monsters of one species grow stronger together.
The prize gold is huge and can pass the 999,999 cap, so spend gold before big wins.

achievements.description: Awarded for winning 1000 battles.
achievements.summary: Win 1000 battles.

steps.text: Keep fighting battles. Check your total in the Info tab.
Avoid using Padfoot or Holy Protection too much, because they skip battles.

achievements.description: Awarded for interacting with 100 sparkly spots on the world map.
achievements.summary: Collect the items from 100 sparkly spots on the overworld.

steps.text: Search the sparkly spots you see on the overworld. The best time to sweep for them is right after you get the Everbird.

achievements.description: Awarded for earning 100,000 gold coins over the course of your adventure.
achievements.summary: Earn a total of 100,000 gold over the adventure.

steps.text: Play normally. Monster Arena prizes alone cover the amount.

achievements.description: Awarded for opening 100 treasure chests.
achievements.summary: Open 100 treasure chests.

steps.text: Open chests as you explore. Mimic chests may not count toward the total, but ordinary chests are plentiful.

achievements.description: Awarded for defeating a metal slime or liquid metal slime for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill any kind of metal slime for the first time; liquid metal slimes count too.

steps.text: Climb to the upper floors of the Tower of Transcendence, which lies north of Alltrades Abbey, and fight metal slimes.
They run away often. Liquid metal slimes also count.

achievements.description: Awarded for changing vocations for the first time.
achievements.summary: Change a party member's vocation for the first time.

steps.text: Level one party member to 20.
Go to Alltrades Abbey, talk to the Abbot, and change to a new vocation.

achievements.description: Awarded for removing the curse placed on Norvik.
achievements.summary: Lift the sleeping curse on the village of Norvik.

guide.context: Optional. Start after you reach Romaria, at about level 10 or higher.

steps.text: Go from Romaria north through the mountains to Khoryv, then to Norvik.
Leave Norvik to the west and find the Faerie Village. Talk to the queen.
Go to the cave at the tip of the peninsula, Underground Lake, and take the Dreamstone from the bottom floor.
Give the Dreamstone to the queen, return to Norvik, and use the Wakey Powder.

achievements.description: Awarded for obtaining the auroral helm.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Auroral Helm from the dwarf at the Shrine of the Dwarf.

guide.context: You can start this in Mur before Baramos, but you cannot finish until the Alefgard part of the story.

steps.text: In Mur, enter the weapon shop through the side entrance and examine the helmet on the shelf.
Talk to the dwarf at the Shrine of the Dwarf, in the snowy north, then talk to your mother.
In Tantegel, talk to Robbin' 'Ood in the church jail on the second floor. Then talk to his men in Quagmire Cave.
In Reeve, ask the old man on the second floor of his house for a wrecking ball.
In Gaia's Navel, go to the room with four staircases and take the north-east one. In the room opposite the Chiromancer fight, break the wall with the wrecking ball and take the blue ore.
Take the ore to the men in Quagmire Cave, then to the dwarf at the Shrine of the Dwarf. After a few days the helm is repaired.

achievements.description: Awarded for obtaining the Sword of Kings.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Sword of Kings by having it reforged in Kol.

steps.text: In Cantlin, get the broken blade from the researcher in the house on the west side.
In Damdara, find the Orichalcum in the stable area in the south-east corner.
Go to Jipang and take the forging hammer from the house marked once you enter.
Take all three to the shop owner in Kol. The reforged sword is ready the next day.

achievements.description: Awarded for being ripped off.
achievements.summary: Get ripped off by paying an inflated price at the Asham equipment shop.

steps.text: Enter the equipment shop in Asham, where nothing shows a price.
Choose an item to buy. Say No to his price three times and accept his final offer, or pay the first price if you can afford it.
Save first if you do not want to lose the gold, then reload afterwards.

achievements.description: Awarded for enjoying a puff-puff.
achievements.summary: Enjoy a puff-puff in Asham.

steps.text: Put a male character first in your party order.
Go to Asham at night. Rest at the inn until night if needed.
Talk to the young woman below the church near the west gate and accept the puff-puff.
After the scene, leave the way you came.

achievements.description: Awarded for obtaining the sage vocation.
achievements.summary: Change a party member to the Sage vocation.

steps.text: Option 1: Level a Gadabout to 20, then change them to Sage at Alltrades Abbey. That alone unlocks it.

Option 2: Find Words of Wisdom in the chest on the high section of the Tower of Transcendence. Cross the rope and drop down by the red flag. Then use it at Alltrades Abbey to change a party member to Sage.
Words of Wisdom is used up when you use it. Another is in a drawer in a house in northern Rimuldar.

achievements.description: Awarded for adding someone to your party for the first time.
achievements.summary: Recruit your first companion into the party.

steps.text: Recruit a companion at Patty's Party Planning Place.

achievements.description: Awarded for acquiescing to the king's request to become ruler of Romaria.
achievements.summary: Accept the King of Romaria's offer to become ruler of Romaria.

guide.context: Not missable. You can say no and accept later. While you rule, you cannot leave Romaria, save at the church, or use magic to leave.

steps.text: Defeat Robbin' 'Ood and take the crown back to the King of Romaria.
Accept the king's offer to rule.
To step down, take the crown to the Monster Arena in Romaria.

achievements.description: Awarded for reviving yourself at a church for the first time.
achievements.summary: Revive your party at a church after a full party wipe for the first time.

steps.text: Save first.
Let the whole party die. One fallen member carried to a church does not count.
On the load screen, choose to revive at the church.
Reviving costs half your gold. Reload your save afterwards to get it back.

achievements.description: Awarded for obtaining the golden claws and escaping the great pyramid's basement.
achievements.summary: Open the sarcophagus in the Pyramid basement and escape with the golden claws.

guide.context: Defeat the Ripper of the Rift first. No magic works in the basement.

steps.text: In the Pyramid, take the north-west stairs from the entrance down to the basement.
Examine the statue in the north-west corner of the basement. A new staircase opens.
Follow the corridor to the sarcophagus and open it to take the golden claws.
Leave the Pyramid. Fights come every few steps and magic is blocked.
Use Soothing Song and healing items, and flee from fights.
